name: simple
plain: Walks the model's own sigma table (1000 entries on a standard discrete model) from the top at an even stride and copies out the entry at the floored offset, which is at or just above the exact position. No interpolation, so every sigma is a value the model was trained on when the model is discrete. It is the first entry of the scheduler list, and KSampler falls back to it for an unknown scheduler name.
math:
S = model_sampling.sigmas (ascending), N = len(S), ss = N/steps.
σ_i = S[N−1−⌊i·ss⌋] for i=0..steps−1, then a final 0.

props.shape: even stride down model sigma table, then 0

label: from code

audit.note: Two errors. (1) "1000-entry" is not general: the code walks len(s.sigmas) (ComfyUI/comfy/samplers.py:648), and that is 10000 on ModelSamplingFlux (model_sampling.py:426) and 50 on the LCM table (nodes_model_advanced.py:28). (2) "nearest lower entry" has the direction backwards: int() floors the offset from the top (samplers.py:650), so the chosen index is at or above the exact position in an ascending table, giving the nearest higher-or-equal sigma.
